About Us

Five decades of moving what others can't

Founded in 1975, J.H. Parabia Transport Pvt. Ltd. has grown into one of India's most experienced heavy-lift and abnormal-load logistics companies. From 190-tonne transformers to giant reactors and industrial columns, our team plans, routes and delivers super-heavy cargo with precision.

  • Specialised hydraulic & multi-axle modular trailers
  • Complete route surveys, permits & escort management
  • Road, rail and sea multimodal capabilities
  • In-house erection, testing & commissioning teams

What We Do

End-to-end heavy logistics solutions

From feasibility study to final commissioning — one partner for the entire project cargo chain.

🏗️

Heavy Haulage & ODC Transport

Super-heavy and over-dimensional cargo movement on hydraulic modular trailers and specialised heavy-duty tractors, up to several hundred tonnes per piece.

🗺️

Logistics Study & Route Feasibility

Detailed route surveys, obstacle mapping, bridge and turning analyses, permit strategy and cost planning before a single wheel turns.

⚡

Erection, Testing & Commissioning

Specialised teams for the erection, testing and commissioning of power transformers and heavy electrical equipment at site.

🚢

Multimodal ODC Transport

Seamless road–rail–sea combinations, including barging and coastal movement, for cargo that cannot travel by a single mode.

📦

Project Material Handling

Complete project material handling and management — port clearance, storage, stuffing, lashing and just-in-time site deliveries.

🛡️

Turnkey Project Logistics

Single-window management of documentation, police escorts, state permits and road closures for time-critical abnormal movements.
